nodes.label: cmd/crio main()
nodes.desc: main (L165): builds the CLI app, validates config, opens the unix socket, creates the gRPC server and calls server.New (L402).

nodes.label: criocli.GetAndMergeConfig
nodes.desc: GetAndMergeConfigFromContext (L35) folds CLI flags, config files and defaults into one libconfig.Config.

nodes.label: libconfig.Config
nodes.desc: Config struct (L119) covers runtimes, storage, image policy, NRI, metrics; DefaultConfig (L1154).

nodes.label: Config.Validate
nodes.desc: Validate (L1276) checks on-disk state at daemon start: runtime binaries, dirs, capabilities.

nodes.label: Server struct
nodes.desc: Server (L69): embeds lib.ContainerServer, tracks pullOperationsInProgress (L85) and the resourceStore (L89).

nodes.label: server.New
nodes.desc: New (L436): lib.New, hostport manager, streaming server, NRI, ociartifact.Store; registers CRI services in cmd/crio (L462).

nodes.label: RunPodSandbox
nodes.desc: RunPodSandbox (L69) validates the runtime handler and delegates to the platform-specific runPodSandbox.

nodes.label: runPodSandbox (linux)
nodes.desc: runPodSandbox (L471) orchestrates sandbox storage (L2110), network (L1991), spec generation and the infra container.

nodes.label: setupSandboxNetwork
nodes.desc: setupSandboxNetwork (L1991) invokes the configured CNI/network plugin and records pod IPs.

nodes.label: setupSandboxStorage
nodes.desc: setupSandboxStorage (L2110) resolves StorageRuntimeServer (L2119) to create the pause-image snapshot for the pod.

nodes.label: StopPodSandbox
nodes.desc: StopPodSandbox (L16) is idempotent per CRI semantics; the linux path (sandbox_stop_linux.go:20) tears down network then containers.

nodes.label: RemovePodSandbox
nodes.desc: RemovePodSandbox (L16) calls removeSandbox (server.go:842) which forwards to lib RemoveSandbox after storage cleanup.

nodes.label: CreateContainer
nodes.desc: CreateContainer (L429): spec generation from the CRI config; setupContainerMounts (L1256) wires volumes and secrets.

nodes.label: setupContainerMounts
nodes.desc: setupContainerMounts (L1256) resolves OCI mounts, host volumes and k8s secrets into specgen mounts.

nodes.label: StartContainer
nodes.desc: StartContainer (L18) resolves the container, then calls ContainerServer.Runtime().StartContainer (L132).

nodes.label: StopContainer
nodes.desc: StopContainer (L20); internal stopContainer (L56) signals via the runtime impl and waits for the exit file.

nodes.label: RemoveContainer
nodes.desc: RemoveContainer (L23) deletes the runtime container, releases the name and drops storage state.

nodes.label: ExecSync
nodes.desc: ExecSync (L15) streams a command into the container through the runtime impl and conmon.

nodes.label: PullImage
nodes.desc: PullImage (L32) blocks concurrent pulls of the same ref via pullOperationsInProgress (L153) then is.PullImage (L423).

nodes.label: RemoveImage
nodes.desc: RemoveImage (L17) untags the image ref via the storage image service.

nodes.label: lib.ContainerServer
nodes.desc: ContainerServer (L48) built by lib.New (L180): sandbox/container stores, ID indexes, StorageImageServer (L140), StorageRuntimeServer (L164).

nodes.label: sandbox.Sandbox
nodes.desc: Sandbox (L33) models one pod: namespaces, infra container, network status, stop mutex, port mappings.

nodes.label: oci.Container
nodes.desc: Container (L45) holds spec, state, pid and conmon metadata; NewContainer (L161) constructs it from specgen.

nodes.label: storage CreatePodSandbox
nodes.desc: runtimeService.CreatePodSandbox (L358) shares createContainerOrPodSandbox (L179) to snapshot the pause image and set labels.

nodes.label: storage CreateContainer
nodes.desc: runtimeService.CreateContainer (L443) creates the container rootfs from the image layer; StartContainer (L570) and StopContainer (L597) persist runtime state.

nodes.label: storage StartContainer
nodes.desc: StartContainer (L570) records the running container name in the store metadata.

nodes.label: storage StopContainer
nodes.desc: StopContainer (L597) flips metadata back to a non-running state and unmounts if needed.

nodes.label: imageService.PullImage
nodes.desc: PullImage (L958) copies layers with containers/image into containers/storage; ListImages (L447), UntagImage (L1101), DeleteImage (L1135).

nodes.label: oci.Runtime
nodes.desc: Runtime (L47) maps runtime handler name to a RuntimeImpl (L60) instance; New (L98) builds it from config.

nodes.label: RuntimeImpl interface
nodes.desc: RuntimeImpl (L60) abstracts Create/Start/Stop/Delete/Exec/Attach so VM runtimes can replace host assumptions.

nodes.label: Runtime.RuntimeImpl()
nodes.desc: RuntimeImpl() (L321) picks the implementation by the container's runtime handler; Runtime.CreateContainer (L385), StartContainer (L455).

nodes.label: runtimeOCI
nodes.desc: Conmon-supervised runc path: CreateContainer (L120) runs conmon, StartContainer (L402), DeleteContainer (L1187), ReadConmonPidFile (L1696).

nodes.label: runtimeVM
nodes.desc: containerd shim v2 client: CreateContainer (L167) boots the shim, StopContainer (L773); talks ttrpc to kata/gvisor shims.

nodes.label: startRuntimeDaemon
nodes.desc: startRuntimeDaemon (L331) spawns the shim binary, captures its stdout, ParseShimAddress (L305) reads the ttrpc address.
